items.title: Inside Liam Lawson's life away from the track
items.content: In the latest instalment of Off The Grid, Liam Lawson clears his schedule for a day to give us a look at his life away from the track – and in return, we take him to a place we know he'll love, just a short drive away from where he lives...

summaries.zh: 新西兰F1车手利亚姆·劳森在“Off The Grid”系列最新一集中，暂时放下赛道日程，展示了他赛场之外的生活。节目组特意带他前往其住所附近一处他定会喜爱的地方，仅需短途车程即可抵达，呈现了这位车手远离赛道的个人一面。
summaries.en: The piece introduces an episode of *Off The Grid* featuring Formula 1 driver Liam Lawson. He sets aside a day to reveal his personal life away from racing. In return, the host takes him to a place they know he will love, located just a short drive from his home. No further details about the location or his off-track activities are given.

items.title: Norris, Piastri and Fornaroli in action for McLaren at Portimao
items.content: Lando Norris, Oscar Piastri and Leonardo Fornaroli were all in action for McLaren on Wednesday as the team carried out Testing of Previous Cars (TPC) running in Portugal.
items.contentSnippet: Lando Norris, Oscar Piastri and Leonardo Fornaroli were all in action for McLaren on Wednesday as the team carried out Testing of Previous Cars (TPC) running in Portugal.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 迈凯伦车队周三在葡萄牙波尔蒂芒进行旧车测试（TPC），兰多·诺里斯、奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里和莱昂纳多·福纳罗利三位车手均参与其中。
summaries.en: McLaren conducted a Testing of Previous Cars (TPC) session at Portimão in Portugal on Wednesday. Regular Formula 1 drivers Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri took part, alongside Leonardo Fornaroli. The running allowed all three drivers to get track time in older McLaren machinery.

items.title: Bearman admits he cannot wait years for Ferrari call
items.content: While Ferrari remains his ultimate goal, Ollie Bearman says he is happy to continue his development at Haas as he weighs up his long-term future.
items.contentSnippet: While Ferrari remains his ultimate goal, Ollie Bearman says he is happy to continue his development at Haas as he weighs up his long-term future.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 奥利·比尔曼表示，虽然法拉利仍是他的终极目标，但他无法等待多年。他目前在哈斯车队继续成长，并对此感到满意，同时正在权衡自己的长远未来。
summaries.en: Ollie Bearman says Ferrari remains his ultimate goal, but he admits he cannot wait years for a call-up. The young driver is content to continue his development at Haas while weighing his long-term future, suggesting he would seek opportunities elsewhere if a Ferrari seat does not materialize soon.

items.title: Why Norris' Hungarian GP win is good news for F1 bettors
items.content: With a third team and fifth different driver standing on the top step of the podium in Budapest, the betting markets are about to get more competitive.
items.contentSnippet: With a third team and fifth different driver standing on the top step of the podium in Budapest, the betting markets are about to get more competitive.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.en: Lando Norris's Hungarian Grand Prix victory made him the fifth different driver and McLaren the third different team to win a race this season. This growing unpredictability in Formula 1 is expected to inject more competition into betting markets, creating better odds and wider opportunities for bettors.
